features: MagSafe-Compatible Magnetic Design : Features a built-in magnetic design compatible with iPhone MagSafe or magnetic cases, keeping your SSD securely attached for effortless storage expansion on the go

Blazing-Fast 20Gbps Speeds : Powered by USB 3.2 Gen2x2 interface and SLC cache, the ESD420 delivers up to 2,000MB/s read/write speeds—ideal for 4K/8K editing, ProRes direct recording, and large media transfers

Universal Compatibility : Compatible with iPhone, Mac, iPad, Android, PS5, Steam Deck, ROG Ally, MSI Claw, Windows, Xbox, laptops, and more. Works with USB 3.2, USB 3.0, and USB 2.0. Pre-formatted as exFAT for seamless plug-and-play across multiple operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android). Not compatible with iPhone’s Lightning port
Compact & Lightweight Portability : Weighing just 48g, this palm-sized SSD easily fits in your pocket or bag, offering powerful storage for photographers, travelers, and creators on the move
Military-Grade Durability : Engineered to MIL-STD-810G standards, the ESD420 withstands accidental drops and bumps, ensuring your data stays safe during tough journeys
